headline.title: SpaceX has a $55 billion plan to build AI chips in Texas
headline.summary: SpaceX plans to invest at least $55 billion to establish a chip manufacturing facility called "Terafab" in Austin, Texas, aimed at producing AI chips. This information was revealed in a public hearing notice filed in Grimes County, as reported by the New York Times and CNBC.

articles.title: Mira Murati’s deposition pulled back the curtain on Sam Altman’s ouster
articles.summary: Mira Murati's deposition revealed details surrounding Sam Altman's sudden ousting as CEO of OpenAI, citing a lack of consistent candor in his communications with the board. The testimony is part of the ongoing legal case Musk v. Altman, shedding light on the internal dynamics at the AI company.

articles.title: Apple’s AirPods with cameras for AI are apparently close to production
articles.summary: Apple's upcoming AirPods featuring cameras are reportedly close to entering early mass production testing, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Current prototypes are undergoing design validation tests, marking a significant step toward potential market release.

articles.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer is now available everyone on Mac
articles.summary: Perplexity's Personal Computer, which integrates AI agents for enhanced functionality, is now available for all Mac users. This release allows users to leverage AI capabilities directly on their devices.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s lawsuit is putting OpenAI’s safety record under the microscope
articles.summary: Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI is scrutinizing the organization's safety record and its alignment with its original mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits humanity. The case raises questions about the impact of OpenAI's for-profit subsidiary on its foundational goals.

articles.title: Bumble is getting rid of the swipe, CEO says
articles.summary: Bumble CEO Whitney Wolfe Herd announced that the company will eliminate the swipe feature in favor of a new direction that emphasizes artificial intelligence. Bumble is developing an AI dating assistant named Bee, which aims to enhance user experiences in love and relationships.

articles.title: ChatGPT’s ‘Trusted Contact’ will alert loved ones of safety concerns
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new optional feature for ChatGPT called "Trusted Contact," allowing users to designate a person who will be alerted if the chatbot detects discussions related to self-harm or suicide. This initiative aims to enhance user safety by notifying friends, family, or caregivers of potential mental health concerns.

articles.title: Startup Battlefield 200 applications close May 27: A shot at VC access, global visibility, TechCrunch coverage, and $100K
articles.summary: Applications for Startup Battlefield 200 are open until May 27, offering startups a chance to gain access to venture capital, global visibility, and TechCrunch coverage, along with the opportunity to win $100,000 in equity-free funding. This program aims to support startups in scaling their impact in the tech industry.

articles.title: Exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Get in front of 10,000 decision-makers before space runs out
articles.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is offering startups the opportunity to secure exhibit space to showcase their products and connect with 10,000 decision-makers. Interested parties are encouraged to reserve a 6' exhibit table soon, as space is limited.

articles.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
articles.summary: Elon Musk and Sam Altman are currently engaged in a court battle regarding the direction of OpenAI, with Musk alleging that the organization has strayed from its original mission of benefiting humanity in favor of profit. The outcome of the trial could significantly impact OpenAI and its flagship product, ChatGPT.

articles.title: 2 days left: Get 50% off a second pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: TechCrunch is offering a promotion for its Disrupt 2026 event, allowing attendees to purchase a second pass at 50% off, with savings of up to $410. This offer is valid until May 8 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

articles.title: China’s Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B valuation as demand for open source AI skyrockets
articles.summary: China's Moonshot AI has secured $2 billion in funding, achieving a valuation of $20 billion, as demand for open-source AI solutions continues to rise. The company's annualized recurring revenue reached over $200 million in April, fueled by increased paid subscriptions and API usage.
